headline: Executive order lets the U.S. freeze the property of people behind serious harmful hacking and other malicious online activity.
what_it_does: This order allows the federal government to block, or freeze, property and assets in the U.S. belonging to certain people or groups found to be involved in significant malicious cyber activity. Blocking property generally means the assets cannot be used, moved, or sold, and Americans generally cannot do business with those listed. The title does not spell out exactly who qualifies or how they are chosen.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups found to be engaged in significant malicious cyber-enabled activities
who_it_affects.how: Their property and interests in property under U.S. control can be frozen.
They generally may not carry out deals with, or handle the frozen property of, people who are blocked under the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 1, 2015; the exact effective date is not stated in the title.
